args.goal: Check prior Canadian RFQ missions and lessons first and reuse equivalent results. Use the queued official CanadaBuys index as navigation if readable. Inspect at most two new original buyer notices for a live, separately quotable offline catalogue, inventory or spreadsheet reconciliation task. Require the buyer's actual acceptance criterion, deadline, response route and any supplier eligibility, registration, confidentiality or disclosed AI-use conditions. Do not assume a large contract may be split or that a listed budget is collectible. For one qualifying notice, run the existing offline check against a fictional pass and fail tied to the quoted criterion, then prepare a private copy-ready response with estimated total effort, provisional CAD price and collection prerequisites. Otherwise record the exact coverage or eligibility gap and what would reopen the route. Save and read back the evidence under products/services/canadabuys-data-qa-intake/ and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission, registration, spending or deployment.
